analysis: Examined base ProviderLoop.swift lines 1024-1290 (ModelSlot, attestation signer selection, companion-file map) and head lines 1-532 (SendHandle, ProviderLoop stored state). Per file_changes (range_map_complete=true), the only head changes are lines 781-792 and 954. They add four stored properties: selectedModelRecovery (SelectedModelRecovery state), selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride (a test seam, nil in production), savedEnabledModels (the config file's enabled_models as last read by the policy refresh), and enabledModelsAtLastSwitch. Line 954 initializes savedEnabledModels from config.config.backend.enabledModels. These lines are visible only in the patch excerpt, not in the supplied head text. The base signer selection (createAttestationSigner, clusterPairingSigner) and ModelSlot hash fields are unchanged. No regression was identified against A-001/A-003, TB-002/TB-003, T-041 or T-053. Questions for integration: (1) ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift is not supplied. Check that the recovery's no-eviction load respects the add-on hold model-load fence (T-059/TB-012) and the drain/shutdown gates. Also check that it does not reload builds tombstoned in retiringModels or failedSelfTestHashes, which would bypass the self-test (head lines 422-430). Recovery loads should still pass weight-hash verification (T-012/T-027). (2) The test seam selectedModelRecoveryLoadOverride must not be settable outside tests, for example through the ProviderLoop+Testing path. (3) The savedEnabledModels status comparison is informational only; confirm it never changes what is advertised without a committed switch. Because the recovery implementation is outside the supplied evidence, needs_deeper_review=true.
